notes: Plays MIDI and tracker modules (mod/s3m/xm/it) via in-app synthesis — real SoundFont banks and the OpenMPT engine. The radio grows WORLD/FAVS/LIST/PICKS tabs: a 400-station directory, a lossless FLAC section, and a starter dial of stream-checked greats. Plus playlist keyboard control, Track Info tabs with the module’s own words, a 1.5× size, right-click Arrange, OS file-type registration, and BIG mode’s DROP toggle.

win.notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.30.0: podcast feeds that refused to load (art19, anchor.fm, Radiotopia's custom domains) now load — the runtime routes around two txiki fetch bugs.

linux.notes: Linux: native 10-band EQ + full AutoEq headphone correction (PipeWire), balance, HLS radio via hls.js, resizable satellite windows, and a 2x double-size mode straight out of Winamp.
